episodes.name: Fantasy Baseball
episodes.overview: Steve tries to get into baseball to connect with Stan. Roger creates real life drama for Francine after her favorite soap opera is cancelled.

episodes.name: I Am The Jeans: The Gina Lavetti Story
episodes.overview: Francine tries to be a better friend to one of Roger's personas who is selling her homemade jeans on TV. Stan and Steve swap eyebrows.

episodes.name: Stan & Francine & Connie & Ted
episodes.overview: Steve introduces Stan and Francine to Barry's parents and Steve regrets it. Roger goes blind.

episodes.name: Rabbit Ears
episodes.overview: Stan gets obsessed with a 1960s television show after picking up a secondhand TV. Roger decides to live as a baby and the family cares for him.

episodes.name: Jeff and the Dank Ass Weed Factory
episodes.overview: Jeff wins a tour through a mysterious weed factory and brings Stan along.

episodes.name: Lost Boys
episodes.overview: Roger breaks up Steve's friendship with Snot, Barry and Toshi. Jeff realizes he has a flair for house flipping and gets Stan, Francine and Hayley involved.

episodes.name: Shark?!
episodes.overview: Stan has Roger pretend to be a shark to help Steve overcome his fears. Hayley's friend Danuta becomes romantically interested in Klaus.

episodes.name: The Long March
episodes.overview: Hayley and Jeff move into a van and start living life on the open road. Francine and Steve are haunted by an Uber driver that they rated poorly.

episodes.name: The Hall Monitor and the Lunch Lady
episodes.overview: Steve goes undercover as a school hall monitor; Roger and Stan go catatonic after witnessing a grisly escalator accident.

episodes.name: Wild Women Do
episodes.overview: Jeff is forced to take Francine out for a not-so-wild night on the town. Klaus forces Steve to watch his celebrity impressions.

episodes.name: An Irish Goodbye
episodes.overview: Francine helps Hayley take a break from their marriages. Stan and Jeff pretend to be frontiersmen.

episodes.name: Stompe Le Monde
episodes.overview: Stan buys the rights a Broadway show after inheriting money from a dead uncle.

episodes.name: Mom Sauce
episodes.overview: Steve’s life is turned upside down when Snot gets rich after his mom starts selling a new dipping sauce. Klaus, Stan, Roger and Jeff become mall fashion show models.

episodes.name: Hamerican Dad!
episodes.overview: Stan, reluctantly invites Roger into his ham club. Francine decides to scare Greg.

episodes.name: Demolition Daddy
episodes.overview: Thanks to Roger, Snot discovers his dead father was a demolition derby driver. Hayley takes Steve on a road trip, so he can learn to drive.

episodes.name: Pride Before the Fail
episodes.overview: Roger tries to force Hayley into graduating from community college so he can move into her room. Klaus repairs Francine’s car.

episodes.name: Enter Stanman
episodes.overview: Roger helps Stan enter Francine’s dreams after he becomes insecure about their contents.

episodes.name: No Weddings and a Funeral
episodes.overview: Klaus leaves the family after one too many harassments. 15 years later, they reconnect for his funeral.

episodes.name: Eight Fires
episodes.overview: Roger helps Francine with her terrible cooking by bringing her to a remote Patagonian island. Stan gets a nail in his head and can’t speak.

episodes.name: The Hand That Rocks the Rogu
episodes.overview: Steve babysits Roger’s ex-tumor, Rogu, to prove to Francine that he’s ready for the responsibility. Stan and Francine get into trouble in their respective clubs.
